description: This file defines utility functions related to combo fields in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving combo box options from the database and generating unique picklist IDs.

methods.name: getComboArray
methods.description: Returns an array of combo field values for specified combo field names by querying the database, taking into account user roles and permissions.

methods.name: getUniquePicklistID
methods.description: Generates and returns a unique ID for picklist values in the vtiger CRM system.
